t.zh: head 取出向量的第一个，类型是 ∀x. Vec (S x) → Elem：只收长 S x 的向量。
t.en: head takes out a vector’s first element; its type is ∀x. Vec (S x) → Elem: it takes only vectors S x long.

after.zh: 别的语言里，取空向量的第一个是运行时的错；长度写进类型以后，它是类型错，程序运行之前就排除了。
after.en: In other languages, taking the first of an empty vector is a runtime error; with the length in the type, it is a type error, ruled out before the program runs.
